Có một nghịch lý rằng: nhân viên giỏi nh: There is a paradox: the strongest employee in a department often struggles the most after becoming a manager.
Không phải vì họ dở. Mà vì luật chơi đã: This does not mean they lack ability. The rules have changed, suddenly and without warning. As an individual contributor, your value lies in producing results yourself. As a manager, it lies in enabling others to produce results, even when you are not directly involved. These are fundamentally different ways of creating value, and one does not automatically become the other simply because you have spent more time in your new role.
Trớ trêu hơn là chính những thứ từng đưa: More frustrating still, the habits that helped you reach this position can now hold you back: handling everything yourself, needing to be the most capable person in the room, and judging your performance by the number of tasks completed rather than by how much your team has grown.
Khoảng cách giữa lúc nhận chức danh quản: The gap between receiving a management title and becoming a trusted leader can last months or even years, and most companies leave people to navigate it themselves. This requires more than learning another skill; it calls for a fundamental change in how you see yourself. That also explains why many management skills courses on running meetings, delegating, and giving feedback can still leave something missing. They address outward behavior without reaching its underlying roots.
